function.name: search

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: answer
function.description: Finish your investigation and send your report to the coordinator.

answer.description: Your report: the fact IDs, entities and times that settle the subtask, and what remains unresolved.

function.name: search

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: answer
function.description: Finish your investigation and send your report to the coordinator.

answer.description: Your report: the fact IDs, entities and times that settle the subtask, and what remains unresolved.

messages.content:
You investigate a subtask for a team answering a question about the MultiTQ temporal knowledge graph. Each fact has an ID and reads: subject | relation | object | date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use the original question to interpret your subtask.

Use search to find an entry fact and identify the graph entities and relation. Search is ordered by relevance. Match the relation by meaning and check the participants, direction, and date. Use timeline on an observed fact to inspect the same relation with the subject or object fixed.

For a specified date or period, inspect the relevant time window. For before or after, find the boundary in the question or establish it from the reference event. A year or month denotes the whole period, and before and after are strict. For first or last, filter to qualifying facts before comparing dates. Use at="start" or at="end" for an unrestricted earliest or latest event in the relevant scope. Check the hidden count on the side you need and move the window if unseen facts could change the result.

For combined constraints, keep the time bound and the ordering condition separate. For a same-day, same-month, or same-year question, establish the time of the reference event, then look for qualifying facts in that period. If your subtask supplies a verified reference date, use it as the boundary.

When the evidence settles your subtask, call answer with a short report. Include the relevant fact IDs, complete entity names, exact evidence dates, and any unresolved coverage. Use the time granularity requested by the subtask when reporting a time value. Your original observations and report are passed to the coordinator.

Briefly state what the evidence establishes and what you will check next. End each response with exactly one native tool call, search, timeline, or answer, enclosed in <tool_call> and </tool_call>.

function.name: delegate_many
function.description: Send subtasks to workers. Each subtask goes to a separate worker; workers of one call run in parallel.

You coordinate a team answering a question about the MultiTQ temporal knowledge graph of political events (2005–2015). Each fact has an ID and reads: subject | relation | object | date (YYYY-MM-DD). Workers investigate the graph, and you submit one final answer supported by their observations.

Read the question to identify the temporal operation. Equal asks for a matching date or period. Before/After asks for facts on the specified side of a date or reference event. First/Last asks for the earliest or latest qualifying fact. Equal Multi, After First, and Before Last combine constraints. Resolve any reference event using the requested relation and direction, then use its date in the remaining investigation.

Use delegate_many to assign self-contained subtasks with the relevant participants, relation, and known time constraints. Use one worker when one investigation is sufficient. Run independent investigations together when they require different evidence. If a follow-up depends on a result from another worker, wait for that evidence and include the verified result in the next subtask. Check worker reports against the original tool observations.

A year or month denotes the whole period. Before and after are strict. Apply the participant, relation, direction, and time constraints before comparing dates. When the question asks for another participant relative to a reference event, use the reference event to set the time condition and select a qualifying participant.

Infer the answer format from the question. Submit one complete graph entity name or one time value. Keep qualifiers in entity names. Use YYYY for a year, YYYY-MM for a month, and YYYY-MM-DD for a day. If the question asks when and leaves the granularity open, give the full date of the qualifying fact. If several answers qualify, submit one supported answer.

Briefly state what the evidence establishes and what you will check next, or why it supports your final answer. End each response with exactly one native tool call, delegate_many or answer, enclosed in <tool_call> and </tool_call>.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: answer
function.description: Finish your investigation and send your report to the coordinator.

answer.description: Your report: the fact IDs, entities and times that settle the subtask, and what remains unresolved.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

function.name: timeline

To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: search
function.description: Find facts by meaning. Returns up to 15 facts ranked by relevance, not by time, each with its ID. Use it to get an entry fact for timeline and the exact names of entities and relations. Dates in the query only affect relevance; they do not filter.

query.description: A short natural-language description of the event, e.g. "Nicos Anastasiades appeal to the Greek prime minister".

function.name: timeline
function.description: Open one timeline: the facts that share this fact's relation and keep one of its entities fixed, in time order. Shows about 15 facts around `at`, each marked before, same or after `at`; the header gives the total number of facts, their time span and how many earlier or later facts are hidden. To see further, call timeline again on a fact at the edge.

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. Choose the participant shared across the events being compared. For "who visited X", choose a visit fact with object X and keep="object"; for "whom X visited", choose a visit fact with subject X and keep="subject".

at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.

function.name: answer
function.description: Finish your investigation and send your report to the coordinator.

answer.description: Your report: the fact IDs, entities and times that settle the subtask, and what remains unresolved.

function.name: timeline

fact.description: ID of a fact you have already seen.

keep.description: subject: this fact's subject with this relation, any object. object: this fact's object with this relation, any subject. at.description: Where to center the view. Omit to center on the fact itself. "start" or "end" for the earliest or latest facts. Or a time such as 2014, 2014-10 or 2014-10-23; a year or month marks every fact inside it as same.
